name: motion-camera-follow
title: Follow with Lookahead
description: Máy quay bám theo vật đang chạy, hơi đi trước theo hướng chạy và có quán tính như lò xo.

moworks.author: moworks

options.subject: selector of the subject inside the world (.ball)
options.lookahead: s of velocity the camera looks ahead (0.47)
options.cap: px max lead (138; 46 on the small frame)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Camera x target = subject x + subject velocity x 0.47 s (look-ahead ~14 frames, capped +-46 px), followed by a spring (stiffness 120, damping 20); background layers move at their depth factor (far 0.4). The demo approximates the spring with an 80 ms lag + a 46 tanh(v / 120) lead on a subject swinging +-220 px every 3 s. Params: lookahead (0.47 s, tối đa 46 px) · spring (120 / 20) · depth nền (0.4).
moworks.titleVi: Máy quay bám theo, nhìn trước
